usedFor: Klaviyo holds campaigns and Google Docs holds your notes, so “New Campaign” can run “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Klaviyo, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each new campaign adds a line to a document tab, giving you a running log of campaigns created.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab’s existing content, so choose add to keep the log.
